summary: First test run for Bernat Solutions MVP. Backend (pytest, 15/15) and frontend (Playwright, 34/34 assertions across home, nav, service details, quote flow, contact flow, login redirect, admin gates) all pass end-to-end against the public preview URL.

issues: H1 text renders without a space between 'Cutting' and '& Fabrication' (renders as 'Steel, Laser Cutting& Fabrication Withoutthe Usual Hassle.'). Likely missing space or word break between JSX spans. Cosmetic only — matches the required assertion but reads awkwardly for an 'Awwwards-level' hero.

action_items: (Optional/design) Fix the missing whitespace in the Home hero H1 so it reads 'Steel, Laser Cutting & Fabrication Without the Usual Hassle.' — currently two words are visually glued together.

(Optional) The public marketing pages call /api/auth/me (returns 401 for anonymous visitors) which shows as red errors in the browser console on every page load. Consider swallowing the 401 in AuthProvider so unauthenticated users don't see console noise on public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: quote submission stores files as base64 inside the same document (up to 8 x 15MB). At scale this will bloat quote documents and slow /api/admin/quotes list responses. Fine for MVP but consider GridFS or separate files collection.

server.py POST /api/auth/session sets cookie with httponly=True, secure=True, samesite='none' — correct for cross-site preview; note the FE also relies on Authorization header fallback which we exercised in tests.
AuthProvider issues /api/auth/me on every public route → 401 console spam. Consider gating the call behind a route matcher or catching 401 silently.
Admin.jsx correctly redirects unauth → /login and non-admin → / with toast; verified in tests.
test_credentials: Admin: session_token='test_session_admin_bernat' → alex@bernatsolutions.com. Non-admin: session_token='test_session_nonadmin' → random@example.com. Both seeded via mongosh into test_database.users + test_database.user_sessions.
seed_data_creation: Seeded two test users + sessions (admin + non-admin). During test runs, a handful of TEST_-prefixed quotes and contact_messages may remain in the DB — not cleaned up automatically to avoid a race with the parallel xdist worker running the lifecycle test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist LoadScope (pinned by pytest.ini). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported into the shell before running pytest (not auto-loaded). Admin/non-admin test tokens must be present in mongosh: rerun the seed block from /app/memory/test_credentials.md before rerunning tests. All /api/admin/* endpoints accept 'Authorization: Bearer <session_token>' as a fallback to the cookie — used throughout the backend suite.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only one cosmetic hero copy issue (missing space) and console noise from /auth/me 401 on public pages.
